concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: exploratory symbol mark for the new project "astrum-scena", an Astro-based engine for small artist and photographer showcase websites.
Create one original logo concept, not an existing brand imitation. The identity combines a star/light with a stage for displaying artworks.
Style: very minimal, precise flat geometric graphic, black ink on pure white, strong silhouette, generous negative space, vector-friendly, sophisticated cultural institution / art publishing sensibility. The mark should remain legible as a small repository avatar or favicon.
Composition: square white canvas, one centered symbol occupying about 45 percent of the canvas width, generous blank margins.
No wordmark, no text, no labels, no numbers, no mockups, no photographs, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no ornament, no rocket or camera pictogram.
Concept: a bold rectangular proscenium / picture opening with a horizontal stage baseline. Use an intentionally open or offset frame rather than a generic closed outline. One small crisp four-point star is suspended within the opening, slightly off center. The star and frame feel structurally integrated, with disciplined proportions and restrained forms. The idea is a tiny stage that makes a single artwork visible.

Concept: a single original interlocking monogram made from the uppercase letters A and S. A is architectural and suggests an open stage entrance, S is integrated through a clean negative-space path or continuous ribbon. Favor clear readable letter structure and clever figure-ground over decorative complexity. Compact, solid, balanced, unusual but immediately reproducible with simple vector geometry. No additional star, frame or independent objects.

Concept: a compact constellation of exactly three circular points linked by one angular line sits inside a deliberately incomplete square picture frame. The constellation suggests three works in an exhibition and evokes stars. One point touches or completes the missing portion of the frame. Make it one coherent symbol, using stout lines and confident circular dots that survive small sizes. Avoid a literal sky, many dots, or a dense network.
